### Findings

1. **Low / Documentation mismatch** — [TESTING.md](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/docs/TESTING.md#L62) vs [actor-scenarios.yml](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/.github/workflows/actor-scenarios.yml#L24-L25)
   - [TESTING.md](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/docs/TESTING.md#L62) states: *"The default is 32 generated scripts; the extended workflow runs 1,000 and TSAN runs eight."*
   - In [actor-scenarios.yml](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/.github/workflows/actor-scenarios.yml#L24-L25), the step `cargo test --locked -p spawned-concurrency --test supervisor_policies` does not set `PROPTEST_CASES=1000`, so it falls back to [`configuration()`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/tests/supervisor_policies.rs#L172-L178), which runs 32 cases unless `PROPTEST_CASES` is set in the workflow environment.

### Verification Summary

- **Registry API Compatibility ([registry.rs](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/registry.rs#L21-L38), [actor.rs](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L584-L592), [system.rs](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/system.rs#L745-L765))**:
  - [`RegistryError`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/registry.rs#L21-L24) is restored to its exact v0.6.0 exhaustive single-variant shape (`AlreadyRegistered(String)`), preserving source and semver compatibility for existing callers and `register_owned`.
  - Unreleased [`Context::register_name`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L584-L592) and internal [`Scope::register`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/system.rs#L745-L765) return the new `#[non_exhaustive]` [`ManagedRegistrationError`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/src/registry.rs#L26-L38) with `#[from] RegistryError` conversion and `OwnerClosed`.
- **Supervisor Policy Oracle ([supervisor_policies.rs](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/tests/supervisor_policies.rs#L39-L169))**:
  - [`apply`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/tests/supervisor_policies.rs#L51-L74) independently models `Permanent`, `Transient`, and `Temporary` restart decisions across `OneForOne`, `OneForAll`, and `RestForOne`.
  - Non-restarting exits (`Temporary`, or normal/shutdown `Transient`) retire only the origin slot (`live = false`).
  - Restarting exits affect only currently `live` slots in the strategy cohort (`index == origin`, all indices, or `index >= origin`): live `Temporary` collateral slots are retired rather than rebuilt, live `Permanent`/`Transient` slots increment `generation`, and already-retired slots are never resurrected.
  - [`observe`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/tests/supervisor_policies.rs#L75-L110) enforces monotonically bounded generation transitions (`actual.generation <= expected.generation`), verifies active generations via request/response fences, and confirms stopped handles reject `current()` and `wait_for_generation()`.
  - Early closure (`close_at`) and deterministic regression coverage ([`retired_temporary_and_transient_slots_stay_retired_across_later_recoveries`](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/concurrency/tests/supervisor_policies.rs#L192-L205)) are sound.
- **CI & Tooling Isolation ([check-api.py](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/scripts/check-api.py#L1-L65), [ci.yml](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L85-L115), [verification.yml](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/.github/workflows/verification.yml#L58-L65))**:
  - [check-api.py](file:///private/tmp/spawned-commonware-notes/scripts/check-api.py#L29-L61) isolates `cargo hack check --each-feature --no-dev-deps` and `cargo semver-checks` inside a `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory` copy of git-tracked/unignored files, preventing manifest/lockfile mutation in the working tree, and safely extracts the baseline archive with `filter="data"`.
